{{PAGENAME}} is produced by grinding [[graphite]] in the [[alchemy mill]]. It can be mixed with [[water]] to produce [[black paint]].

Note: You must study [[graphite]] at the [[study table]] before you can grind it at the [[alchemy mill]].
